summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Lost Things
summary.text: Florentine codex contents on astrological questions concerning lost objects, thieves, runaways, imprisonment, exile, contests, tribunals, and the truth of inquiries, with cross-references to Hephaestion of Thebes, Dorotheus, and related publications.
